messages:
Iris (PM): Folks — we need a short, concrete GA decision for observability: what sampling defaults, cost bands, and launch gates do we commit to? Customers want clarity.

Diego (ENG): Backend can do per-tenant sampling + adaptive uplifts. My recommended defaults: default_sample_rate=0.001 (0.1%), error_preserve=0.10, adaptive rules for sustained error spikes. Expose budget_usd on tenant config.

Mei (SRE): Ops requirement: three preset bands (dev $10/day, team $60/day, enterprise manual). Hard cap default $120/day. On cap: 1) downgrade spans to headers-only; 2) reduce sample_rate by 90%; 3) mark tenant as THROTTLED in Console and notify owner. Also global kill-switch if multiple tenants throttle.

Owen (ML): For launch acceptance: run 48h canary across three tenants. Success if recall of prioritized error clusters >= 92% at default rates OR targeted retention enabled for failing tenants. Also anomaly-detection F1 degradation <= 5%.

Iris (PM): Console UX summary: tenant card shows "Budget today (USD)", "Projected 24h", and sampling badge (normal/uplifted/throttled). Two quick actions: "Pause high-fidelity traces" and "Request increased retention" (enterprise).

Diego (ENG): API sketch ("single-line"): sampling_policy={default_rate:0.001,error_preserve_pct:0.1,adaptive:[{when:'error_rate>1%',set:0.01,ttl:3600}]},budget_usd=60

Mei (SRE): Runbook notes: if >2 tenants throttle in 24h, revert to conservative global_sample_rate=0.0005 and notify oncall. Add throttled-tenants dashboard and ability to mute tenant alerts during support windows.

Owen (ML): Canary plan: pick 3 tenants (enterprise, mid-market, internal stress). Run recall evals at 24h and 48h and deliver a short report. If recall < 92%, enable targeted retention for that tenant and re-run.

Iris (PM): Draft launch checklist: 1) Sampling API + Console edit UI (owner: Diego) 2) Budget enforcement + throttle UX + runbook (owner: Mei) 3) Canary evals + acceptance report (owner: Owen) 4) Customer docs + billing FAQ (owner: Iris).

Diego (ENG): Timeline: sampling + budget enforcement in 2 sprints, Console card in sprint 3, throttle fast-path in parallel sprint 2. I'll open PR for schema today.

LaunchBot: Created ticket: github.com/redwood/infer/issues/2201 "tenant-sampling-budget-playbook" assigned to @Diego.

Iris (PM): Ok — reconvene Friday 10am to sign off on canary plan and customer messaging. :white_check_mark:
